title: Chart questions
summary: Every chart question of the Reports submenu and drag-lint ask, imported from REPORT_QUESTIONS
intro: Put the caret on a routine, field, type or unit and pick a question from drag-lint > Reports, or run `drag-lint ask <id> --target <name> --project <dproj>`; you get a clickable chart and a DocInsight text answer. Needs a fresh project index and Graphviz for the pictures.
